snippet.title: Flesh Made Fear - Official Launch Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Flesh Made Fear is bringing classic horror elements to modern times, including tank controls, fixed cameras, and pure terror. This game is set in a haunted world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, and forges a new terrifying path forward by honors the horrors that game before it. Flesh Made Fear will be released on PC on October 31, 2025.

#ign #gaming
